requirement: The target type of an is-type operator cannot be dynamic.
notes: Retired; no program requirement is stated for this target.
retirement_reason: The phrase defines the domain of E is T for T other than dynamic; it does not forbid a program. The ID is never reused.

requirement: Native integer constant folding uses the fixed signed or unsigned thirty-two-bit domain rather than the execution target's pointer width.
notes: Committee prose read at both registered pins before proposal; registered csc is the authority.
retirement_reason: The broad fixed-Int32/UInt32-folding draft is not the registered csc behavior. Native complement and architecture-dependent shifts are not constants on the pinned net11 target at C#9. Small constant arithmetic remains covered by existing P09-native-constants. Observed with the registered csc. Test mapping: iot-native-constant-domain to iot-native-constant-arithmetic, iot-native-complement-constant-reject and iot-native-dependent-shift-reject.

quote_json: "all components are constant expressions of type `string`"
requirement: An interpolated string whose holes are constant string expressions without alignment or format specifiers is a constant string expression with the concatenated text and hole values.
notes: Committee prose read at both registered pins before proposal; registered csc is the authority.
retirement_reason: The registered csc rejects a null-valued constant string hole. The draft also asserted that this was constant and its original test failed CS0133. Observed with the registered csc. Test mapping: iot-constant-interpolation-holes to the nonnull-strings ID, plus iot-constant-interpolation-null under the distinct null rejection ID. csc is the post-edition authority; no runtime null interpolation behavior is changed.
